description: No one owes us anything and that keeps my boundaries in alignment and in focus #boundarysetting #selflove #selfpresservation
transcript: No one owes us anything. They don't owe us an explanation, they don't owe us this course, they don't owe us closure. The more that we live in understanding that we are not the only people existing in the world, others are having their own experiences, the less I take things personal. None of it is about me, it is more about someone else's experiences and I happen to just be a part of the process. I do not take anything personal because it's not about me.
